subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:542-545 calls beginLoad only when a cURL import reply arrives; tools-sheet.tsx:295-298 retains that callback after the sheet closes. The reply therefore acquires the current collection and a fresh generation instead of retaining its initiating lifetime. Independently reproduced: defer import observation, let the core select the imported draft, close Import, select health and load its editor, then release the import reply. Health remains selected but its editor, Send and response pane disappear without an error or recovery control. Acceptance: capture the import's collection lifetime and load generation before dispatch, retire it when superseded, and ignore obsolete replies. Add deferred-import regressions covering selection changes and collection close/reopen, while preserving normal import display.

R2 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:119-127,150-155 stores tree-open failures only in loadFailure, while :481 displays them only if the failed request is already selected. Native open_request (crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain.rs:1554) leaves the previous selection unchanged when reading the new request fails. Independently reproduced clicking an unselected health tree entry with a missing-file refusal and then a lost observation: both produce zero alerts and no Try again; the old editor remains with no explanation. The regression at api-client.test.tsx:524 preselects the failed request and misses this production path. Acceptance: expose the attempted tree request's refused or undelivered result accessibly in the current collection even when selection stays unchanged, retain the previous editor, and permit an explicit retry without automatic replay. Cover both outcomes without fabricating a successful selection.
limitations: Independent checks used the actual React components, transpiled in memory with TypeScript and rendered in jsdom, with synthetic dispatch, observation and snapshots. Reproduced both findings and verified the previous attempt's tree-reply retirement, pending-load close/reopen and in-dialog creation-refusal fixes. No application source was changed, product endpoint called or credential accessed.
